conclusion_zh: 四份PDF中的未嵌入Helvetica都没有实际绘字：正文仅第6页/Fm3（图4）保留1次空初始化；补充18页均有默认初始化，表格另有10pt空初始化。所有实际绘字字体均已嵌入。

minimum_existing_pdf_cleanup.target: Only content streams whose local font resource resolves to unembedded Helvetica; include nested Figure4 Form in main page6 and each supplementary page.
required_deletions: Remove every associated Helvetica Tf operator in its own content scope. Preserve unrelated TL/BT/ET operators unless separately proving their state is redundant.
Then remove only the now-unused matching /Font resource entry in that same scope; do not merely delete the resource while leaving dangling Tf references.
Retain all other raw stream bytes, not a global ContentStream float reserialization, to preserve exact drawing coordinates.
Write a new PDF; original four baseline PDFs remain unchanged.
scoped_token_examples: Supplement page scope: /F1 12 Tf and table-related /F1 10 Tf
strict_preconditions: No text-show operator runs under that font, including across q/Q and nested Form states.
Every Helvetica selection is in an empty BT/Tf/TL/ET text object in the audited baselines.
Do not remove similarly named fonts in other resource scopes.
verification: Every font resource remaining is embedded (apart from any explicitly justified non-text font).
No remaining Tf references removed resources.
Same page counts, text, metadata/anonymity and image dimensions.
Before/after 300dpi pixel difference zero on all pages; no new missing-font renderer warnings.

reproducible_source_prevention.figure4: ReportLab Canvas(overlay, ..., initialFontName="OriginalFigureDejaVuSansBold", initialFontSize=9) after registering that TTFont prevents the Helvetica preamble; keep all title text/drawing positions unchanged.
reproducible_source_prevention.supplement_canvas: Pass a custom canvasmaker or functools.partial(Canvas, initialFontName="DejaVu") to doc.build; existing registered dynamic TTFont prevents the initial Helvetica Tf.
reproducible_source_prevention.supplement_tables: Add TableStyle FONTNAME for all cells to DejaVu. Paragraphs keep their own explicit fonts and sizes; this removes default Helvetica10 table setup even when every cell is a Paragraph.
reproducible_source_prevention.local_library_evidence: Installed ReportLab Canvas._make_preamble skips initialization Tf for dynamic TTFonts; Table._drawCell calls setFont(cellstyle.fontname,...) before drawing Paragraph cells, explaining the otherwise unused 10pt Helvetica selections.
reproducible_source_prevention.final_guard: Still perform recursive resource/Tf audit after generation; do not assume changing initial canvas font alone removes table defaults.
